integration_issues.issue: Endpoint returns 400 'No keys with usage, or email service unavailable' for doctester even though key has 9 req / 29 tokens visible in dashboard. Likely Resend restricted delivery masks as email-service-unavailable OR the receipts eligibility check ('keys with usage') is looking at a different collection/window than the UI shows. Not a blocker per review note (Resend restriction expected), but consider surfacing a clearer 'Email delivery restricted' message vs. 'No keys with usage' — the two conditions collapse into one error and confuse the user.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span>' cannot be a child of '<option>' — some <select><option> renders a span inside. Repro across /dashboard and /auth. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.
Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on dashboard usage chart — container size 0 during first paint. Consider minHeight on ResponsiveContainer.
Still opens in Register mode by default (carried over from iter29–32).

action_items: (Optional) Split the 400 in POST /api/receipts/send-now into two distinct error codes/messages: 'no_usage' vs 'email_service_unavailable' — currently users can't tell which case they're in.
(Optional) Fix hydration warning: '<span>' inside '<option>' — search for <option> renders that wrap content in <span>.
(Optional) Default /auth to Sign-In mode when redirected from a protected route (carry-over).
critical_code_review_comments: PLAN_QUOTAS + _enforce_plan_quotas is centralized (good) — consider exposing remaining tokens via a rate-limit response header on /v1/chat/completions (X-Monthly-Tokens-Remaining) so SDK consumers can preemptively back off before 429.

Admin audit uses ad-hoc string search ('grant'/'suspend') for asserting — schema of audit entries isn't strongly typed. If you plan to build filters/UI on the admin audit panel, define an enum for action types.
Games portal player routes correctly declared before /{game_id} — no regressions from route ordering. Good.
Games favorites use a single POST toggle endpoint (no DELETE). This is fine but non-RESTful; document explicitly or add a DELETE for symmetry.
Receipts eligibility check couples 'has usage' and 'email service available' into a single 400 — split into distinct HTTP responses (400 vs 503).
